## Load one byte {#machine-load}

::: {.sa-scene .sa-grid}
::: {.sa-panel}
**Byte-addressed memory**

::: {.sa-tree}
::: {.sa-row}
`0x20` · `3C`
:::
::: {.sa-row .fragment .custom .sa-mark data-sa-beat="address"}
`0x21` · `A5`
:::
::: {.sa-row}
`0x22` · `00`
:::
:::

::: {.sa-note-slot}
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="address"}
Drive address `0x21` on the bus.
:::
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="capture"}
Capture the response in the low byte of the register.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.sa-panel}
**Register · R0**

::: {.sa-register data-sa-beat="capture"}
<span>7 · 1</span><span>6 · 0</span><span>5 · 1</span><span>4 · 0</span><span>3 · 0</span><span>2 · 1</span><span>1 · 0</span><span>0 · 1</span>
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script type="application/json" data-sa-beats>{"scope":"#machine-load","beats":["address","capture"]}</script>
```

## Forward a pipeline result {#forward-result}

::: {.sa-scene .sa-grid}
::: {.sa-panel}
**Execute**

`ADD R2, R0, R1`

::: {.sa-row data-sa-beat="produce"}
`R2 = 0x000A`
:::
:::

::: {.sa-panel}
**Next instruction**

`XOR R3, R2, R4`

::: {.sa-row data-sa-beat="forward"}
`R2 ← 0x000A`
:::
:::
:::

::: {.sa-scene .sa-note-slot}
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="produce"}
The ALU produces the sum before register writeback.
:::
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="forward"}
Forward the sum to the dependent instruction.
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script type="application/json" data-sa-beats>{"scope":"#forward-result","beats":["produce","forward"]}</script>
```

## Save a return address {#save-return}

::: {.sa-scene .sa-grid}
::: {.sa-panel}
**Call site**

`0x108: CALL process`

::: {.sa-row data-sa-beat="push"}
Return to `0x10C` after the call.
:::
:::

::: {.sa-panel .sa-dropzone data-sa-qa-fixed="stack"}
**Stack**

::: {.sa-tree}
::: {.sa-row data-sa-beat="push"}
`SP = 0x7FFC` · `0x10C`
:::
::: {.sa-row}
`0x8000` · previous frame
:::
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script type="application/json" data-sa-beats>{"scope":"#save-return","beats":["push"]}</script>
```

## Retire the head of a queue {#retire-queue}

::: {.sa-scene}
```{=html}
<svg class="sa-svg" viewBox="0 0 900 190" role="img" aria-label="Queue entry A travels from the head slot to the consumer">
  <path id="queue-route" d="M 160 77 H 780" class="sa-rail"/>
  <g fill="#f0f2f4" stroke="#676a70">
    <rect x="100" y="40" width="120" height="74" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="230" y="40" width="120" height="74" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="720" y="40" width="120" height="74" rx="8"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="22" text-anchor="middle"><text x="290" y="84">B</text><text x="160" y="149">Head</text><text x="780" y="149">Consumer</text></g>
  <g id="queue-entry"><rect x="-22" y="-22" width="44" height="44" rx="8" fill="#713e2b"/><text x="0" y="8" style="fill:white" font-size="23" text-anchor="middle">A</text></g>
</svg>
```

::: {.sa-note-slot}
::: {data-sa-beat="take"}
The consumer takes **A**. **B** stays queued.
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script type="application/json" data-sa-timeline>
{
  "scope":"#retire-queue","beats":["take"],
  "paths":{"queue":{"path":"#queue-route","stops":{"head":0,"consumer":1}}},
  "tokens":{"entry":{"selector":"#queue-entry","print":true}},
  "initial":{"entry":{"path":"queue","stop":"head"}},
  "steps":[{"beat":"take","tokens":{"entry":{"path":"queue","stop":"consumer"}}}]
}
</script>
```
